name: Remote Cliamp
author: orsa
description: Control cliamp players on remote servers over SSH-forwarded sockets — or the local cliamp with zero config. One widget, a server picker in the panel, live state per server.

barWidget.description: Cliamps on other machines driven over SSH — and the local one — switched from one panel.

schema.label: LedFx URL
schema.description: http(s) address of a LedFx instance, e.g. http://lights.lan:8888. Empty hides the LIGHTS section.

schema.label: Hide the icon when the active server is unreachable
